title: The Rural English Villages Around RAF Fairford at the Center of a Possible Terrorist Plot
description: The quiet rural area around R.A.F. Fairford, where U.S. bombers fly to Iran, was thrust into the spotlight after the authorities said they were investigating a possible terrorist plot targeting the base.

title: Estonia Says Arson at Defense Company Was ‘Deliberate’ Attack by Russia
description: A fire broke out at Milrem Robotics, which manufactures and supplies unmanned vehicles for Ukraine, in August.

title: Da Hawaiian Hitman eyes status as Power Slap’s ‘greatest super heavyweight’

title: Oil prices rise for second session on continued Middle East supply concerns
description: BENGALURU: Oil prices rose for a second successive session on Tuesday as lingering concern over Middle East supply disruption brought about by ​the US-Israeli war on Iran outweighed signs of recovering crude exports from the ‌region. Brent crude futures for November rose $1.71, or 1.6 percent, to $106.99 a barrel at 09:26 a.m. Saudi time, while the more actively traded Brent December contract rose $1.68 to $99.51 a barrel. title: Officials: Israel kills leader in Hamas armed wing
description: An Israeli airstrike killed Izz el-Din al-Baik, a leader in Hamas’s armed wing, in the northern Gaza Strip. Israeli sources stated he was involved in planning attacks and recruiting militants.

title: Golf Saudi strengthen long-term commitment to women’s game
description: RIYADH: Golf Saudi has announced a multi-year commitment to The Championship, a world-class women’s tournament in the UK, which from 2027 will be co-sanctioned by the LPGA and the Ladies European Tour, with a prize fund of $4 million. title: Iran FM says expects US answer Tuesday on plan to open Hormuz
description: Iran’s Foreign Minister expects a US response to a proposal regarding the opening of the Strait of Hormuz. Discussions facilitated by Qatari intermediaries aim to address regional maritime issues.

title: Trump denies he offered Iran sanctions relief, release of frozen funds
description: Donald Trump has refuted claims that he proposed sanctions relief and released frozen funds to Iran. The report by Axios was called inaccurate by Trump on his Truth Social platform.

title: UK police release on bail five men held over airbase incident
description: British police have released five men on bail after they were arrested near a US airbase. The release comes amid claims from Washington of a ‘foreign actor’ being involved in a suspected bomb plot.

title: North Korean DMZ landmine blasts ‘violation of armistice’: Seoul
description: Seoul has declared that landmine explosions in the DMZ, which injured three South Korean soldiers, were instigated by North Korea, violating the armistice agreement.

title: Report: CIA warned Europe of Russian drone attack from vessels in the Mediterranean
description: The CIA reportedly warned European nations of a suspected Russian plot to launch explosive drones from aboard commercial vessels in the Mediterranean.

title: 'Class sizes of more than 36 people': student protests continue in Paris and beyond
description: Teenagers in France have been blockading their schools and demonstrating since last week to protest a string of grievances. Standing in front of the Lycée Hélène Boucher, FRANCE 24 journalist Antonia Kerrigan said students there said there were "class sizes of more than 36 people". Click on the video for more.

title: Iran says it expects US response Tuesday on plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran expects Washington to respond to its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday. In exchange for reopening the vital shipping route, Tehran is seeking guarantees including a regional ceasefire, the lifting of sanctions on its oil sector and an end to the US naval blockade.

title: Public transport drivers strike in Manila over soaring fuel prices
description: Public transport drivers in Manila begin a three-day strike over soaring fuel prices.

title: Asian Games: South Korea volleyball team latest to be taken to wrong venue
description: Transporting athletes to the wrong location has emerged as a recurring issue at the Asian Games in Japan.

title: Can Pakistan’s Sohail Afridi win freedom for ex-PM Imran Khan?
description: At 37, hes the PTIs top elected leader. But the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa chief minister is assuming a national role too.
